steps.title: What is it used for?
steps.note: Transactional (OLTP) or analytical (OLAP); batch or stream processing

steps.title: Who is doing the work?
steps.note: Database administrator, data engineer or data analyst: look for the verb

steps.note: Relational services, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, or Fabric, Databricks and Power BI
